name: EU Medical Device Regulation (MDR 2017/745 / IVDR)
description: Compliance framework for the EU Medical Device Regulation (MDR - Regulation (EU) 2017/745) and In Vitro Diagnostic Medical Devices Regulation (IVDR - Regulation (EU) 2017/746), covering clinical evaluation, CE mark technical documentation, UDI tracking, and EUDAMED registration.
owner: EU Medical Device Regulatory Affairs & Notified Body Office

checklists.name: EU MDR 2017/745 Technical Audit Checklist
checklists.description: Validation checklist for EU MDR Annex I General Safety and Performance Requirements (GSPR) and software Rule 11.

items.statement: Medical Device Software classification under Rule 11 (Class I, IIa, IIb, III) is documented with clinical justification.
ISO 14971 risk management file assesses all software hazards and verifies risk reduction to acceptable levels.
EN 62304 software development lifecycle evidence demonstrates architectural verification and unit testing.
Basic UDI-DI and UDI-PI are assigned and integrated into software release metadata.
Post-Market Clinical Follow-up (PMCF) plan establishes systematic data collection on real-world software performance.

reviewGates.name: EU MDR Person Responsible for Regulatory Compliance (PRRC) Gate
reviewGates.statement: The PRRC confirms that clinical evaluation, technical documentation, and UDI assignments comply with EU MDR 2017/745.
reviewGates.prompt: Does the technical documentation package satisfy EU MDR CE mark certification requirements?

obligationDefinitions.title: Post-market surveillance data must be reviewed and reported per the device's risk class
obligationDefinitions.description: EU MDR/IVDR require an ongoing Post-Market Surveillance (and, for higher-risk devices, PMCF) process producing periodic reports; a CE mark obtained at launch does not discharge this continuing duty.
obligationDefinitions.completionCriteria: The Periodic Safety Update Report (or PMCF report) is produced within the cadence required for the device's risk classification.

requiredEvidence.title: Post-market surveillance report
requiredEvidence.description: Periodic Safety Update Report or PMCF report for the device.
requiredEvidence.collectionMethod: Post-market surveillance system, reviewed on the required cadence.

obligationDefinitions.prompt: Has the required post-market surveillance report been produced on schedule?
